discrete.contest: NFL Showdown $1.11M Sunday Night Showdown [$250K to 1st] (DAL @ NYG)

sim_stamp.dst: components of the opposing offense in the same world, shifted to the Sleeper mean by whole points plus a coin for the fraction
sim_stamp.kicker: extra points off the offense's own touchdowns, field goals at a Poisson mean solved so the level lands on the projection
sim_stamp.lattice: every score recomputes from integer components through DraftKings' own scorer -- offense, kicker and defense alike -- so all of them are reachable (research/sd_support)
sim_stamp.marginals: component means scaled BEFORE the draw so the mean lands on Sleeper with whole yards and catches; no multiply touches a finished score
sim_stamp.receiving_noise: none beyond the shared game, team-passing and script factors

legacy.contest: NFL Showdown $1.11M Sunday Night Showdown [$250K to 1st] (DAL @ NYG)

sim_stamp.dst: components of the opposing offense in the same world, shifted to the Sleeper mean
sim_stamp.kicker: extra points and field goals off the offense, then rescaled to the projection
sim_stamp.lattice: scores sit on a 0.01 grid; DK offence lives on 0.02 (research/sd_lattice)
sim_stamp.marginals: each player's points rescaled to the Sleeper mean after the loop
sim_stamp.receiving_noise: none beyond the shared game, team-passing and script factors
